storyCards.headline: Best I Ever Had: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Drake's "Best I Ever Had" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Best I Ever Had" is a song by the Canadian rapper Drake from his third mixtape So Far Gone.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.

Best I Ever Had was released in 2009.
